agentBrowser.description: agent-browser CLI (auto-detects Chrome, falls back to Edge)

llmKeys.description: No LLM API key needed — agent-browser uses built-in browser automation, not AI-driven navigation. Available keys in /home/workspace/credentials/.env: Groq (5), Cerebras (6), Gemini (4) — usable by other skills that need LLM inference.

setupInstructions: No API key required for basic browser automation
For LLM-driven navigation tasks, set GROQ_API_KEY_1, CEREBRAS_API_KEY_1, or GEMINI_API_KEY_1 as needed
Test: agent-browser open https://example.com && agent-browser snapshot -i -c
verifySetup: Run 'agent-browser open https://example.com' then 'agent-browser snapshot -i -c' to verify
